what: Compás turns the FM-1 into a Latin rhythm section: cumbia, salsa, merengue and bolero. Cue sections and the whole band lands together. Includes 29 groove studies, 28 song arrangements, TR-727 percussion, Hanan Kumbia Kit and English and Spanish builds.
